name: Aminatou, Veil Piercer
oracle_text:
At the beginning of your upkeep, surveil 2. (Look at the top two cards of your library, then put any number of them into your graveyard and the rest on top of your library in any order.)
Each enchantment card in your hand has miracle. Its miracle cost is equal to its mana cost reduced by {4}. (You may cast a card for its miracle cost when you draw it if it's the first card you drew this turn.)
blocked_sentences: Each enchantment card in your hand has miracle. Its miracle cost is equal to its mana cost reduced by {4}.

needs.what: a grant_miracle static whose miracle cost is relative to each granted card's own mana cost -- the card's printed mana cost with {4} of generic removed (never below zero generic, coloured pips kept) -- rather than one fixed price string
needs.why_existing_wont_do: grant_miracle's miracle_cost is a single fixed mana string (Molecule Man's "{0}") that player_statics.granted_miracle_cost returns verbatim for every matching card; there is no way to say 'this card's mana cost minus {4}'. spell_cost_reduction discounts every cast of enchantments, not only the miracle cast, and grant_warp/granted_alternative_cost are likewise fixed prices offered at any cast
